title: Implicit logspace computability of identity
statement: The identity function on finite bit strings is implicitly logspace computable: its output length is bounded by $C(|x|+1)^c$ for some natural numbers $C,c$ on every input $x$, and both the language of encoded pairs $(x,	ext{bits}(i))$ for which output bit $i$ is $1$ and the language of such pairs for which $i$ is less than the output length are decidable in logarithmic space.
